trips.name: North Gaspé
trips.note: m.v. North Gaspé, the Clarke 5 1/2-day Gaspé cruise: Montreal (Victoria Pier) Tuesday 7.30 p.m., Quebec Wednesday morning, Ste-Anne-des-Monts Thursday, Gaspé Friday, back by Ste-Anne-des-Monts Saturday and Quebec Sunday to Montreal Monday morning (the 1945 advertisement; 1948 season from May 11). Alternate weeks she made the 7-day cruise to the Magdalen Islands instead (Montreal Monday 7.30 p.m.); counting from May 11, the week of 5 July is a Gaspé week. Coast calls and hours ESTIMATED.
